About Criccona

A coffee and cocoa alliance built around farmers, communities and fair markets.

Who we are

Criccona Coffee-Cocoa empowers local farmers in Uganda through sustainable coffee and cocoa farming, connecting them to reliable markets. We work with Ugandan growers, processors and exporters to deliver quality coffee and cocoa while improving livelihoods.

Based in Kabaga, Kiteezi, we are open to farmers, cooperatives, processors, buyers, exporters, policymakers and institutions across the value chain.

What guides us

  • Farmer first: training, fair trade and inclusion for youth and women.
  • Sustainability: climate-smart farming, biodiversity and carbon credit pathways.
  • Quality & traceability: consistent quality and digital traceability for buyers.
  • Partnership: working with governments, NGOs and institutions to shape better policy.

Standards & trust

Traceability

Digital traceability from farm to shipment.

International standards

Compliance with international buyer requirements.

Fair trade

Fair, transparent pricing and premium positioning for producers.

Frequently asked questions

General

Who can join Criccona?

Criccona is open to farmers, cooperatives, processors, buyers, exporters, policymakers, and institutions working within the coffee and cocoa value chains.

What services do you provide?

We offer end-to-end support: farmer training, input supply, post-harvest processing, market access, cooperative strengthening, sustainability programs, advocacy, and research & innovation.

How do farmers benefit from Criccona?

Farmers gain access to training, improved seedlings, fair trade opportunities, and stronger market linkages that increase income and resilience.

Do you work with international buyers?

Yes. We connect local producers to regional and global buyers, ensuring traceability, premium quality, and compliance with international standards.

How does Criccona promote sustainability?

We champion climate-smart farming, biodiversity protection, carbon credit opportunities, and community development programs in education, health, and livelihoods.

Can youth and women participate?

Absolutely. We run entrepreneurship programs and inclusive initiatives to ensure youth and women thrive in coffee and cocoa businesses.

How can I partner with Criccona?

Reach out through our contact page to explore partnerships in farming, processing, trade, policy, or research.

Who we are
